data.gender_notes: Ghaada is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'ghad' meaning 'to break through, to emerge', Ghaada is a beautiful and meaningful name for a girl. In Islamic tradition, it symbolizes the radiance and shining light of faith and spiritual growth. The name can be traced back to various sources in the Quran and Hadith. The name Ghaada carries the meaning “Radiant, shining” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ghaada usually hope their child will grow to embody radiant, shining and live with faith, good character and purpose.
